broker.name: HFM
broker.tagline: On its own site since 2010. Its site names 6 regulators, including CySEC, FCA, and FSCA. Rules depend on where you live. Advertised leverage: Unlimited.
broker.about: HFM says it has operated since 2010. The pages checked do not name one headquarters. Account names on its site include InfinityX, Cent, Zero, Pro, and Premium. Platforms named there include MetaTrader 4, MetaTrader 5, HFM WebTrader, HFM App, HFM Platform, and TradingView charts inside the browser platform. The site names these regulators: CySEC, FCA, FSCA, FSA (Seychelles), CMA (Kenya), and FSC (Mauritius). The company on an account depends on where the client lives. Minimum deposit is not a single number on the pages that loaded. The highest leverage figure taken from those pages is Unlimited. Leverage increases losses as well as gains.
broker.regulators_note: The company behind an account depends on where you live. CySEC: HF Markets (Europe) Ltd, 183/12. FCA: HF Markets (UK) Ltd, 801701. FSCA: HF Markets SA (PTY) Ltd, 46632. FSA (Seychelles): HF Markets (Seychelles) Ltd, SD015. CMA (Kenya): HFM Investments Ltd, 155. FSC (Mauritius).
platforms: TradingView charts inside the browser platform

broker.leverage_note: Leverage increases losses as well as gains, and you can lose more than you deposit. The highest figure on this card is the highest number this broker advertises. It is not the cap on every account. The cap depends on the company, the product and where you live.

other_fees.label: Minimum deposit
other_fees.note: Account minimums differ. The comparison page says InfinityX $500, Cent $0, Zero $0 or EUR 0, Pro $100 or EUR 100, and Premium $0 or EUR 0. Payment-method minimums are separate: bank transfer $100, card $5, and two unnamed alternative methods at $30 and $10.

other_fees.label: Deposit fee
other_fees.value: HFM says it does not apply any deposit fees
other_fees.note: The bank-transfer row says no fees for deposits over $100. The page does not state the fee, if any, below $100. Card row says no fees. Two alternative rows say no fees but do not name the method.

_notes.fetch_notes: Homepage and international English pages loaded. The about page says HFM Group was founded in 2010 and does not name a headquarters. A London phone number and the UK registered office are published. The 2010 Mauritius FSC licence is on the about timeline only. The regulatory environment page does not repeat it or give a number. The homepage says zero-spread quotes are delayed and that commissions apply. That line is not tied to one account in the fetch. Formerly HotForex is the name in the research request. The pages fetched use HFM and HF Markets, and the about timeline says the brand evolved into HFM in 2022.
_notes.company_details_not_listed: HF Markets (Seychelles) Ltd, Seychelles registration 8419176-1. HF Markets (SV) Ltd is described as an International Business Company in St. Vincent and the Grenadines, registration 22747 IBC 2015. That SVG entry is company registration, not a financial-services licence, so it is not listed as a regulator. HF Markets (UK) Ltd company registration 11118651, Bloomsbury Building, 10 Bloomsbury Way, Holborn, London WC1A 2SL, appears on the deposit page footer. A Cyprus company number for HF Markets (Europe) Ltd was not on the regulatory page.
